title: ACE: Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation via Zero-shot Workflow Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2607.04162v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: General-purpose manipulation requires both semantic reasoning over task constraints and reliable execution of contact-rich actions. We present ACE, an agentic manipulation harness that composes a high-level language agent with a reusable mask-conditioned visuomotor policy. Given an open-ended instruction, the agent solves semantic constraints, binds objects to destination roles, and decomposes the task into executable transfers represented by tracked pick-and-place masks. Execution feedback supports outcome assessment, re-grounding, and retry, while persistent object and task context preserves earlier associations when manipulation changes visible cues. We evaluate ACE on two physical multi-step tabletop tasks, Semantic Formula Assembly and Constraint Retrieval. The visuomotor policy is trained only on generic pick-and-place demonstrations and reused without complete demonstrations of either evaluation task, enabling task-level

translated_title: ACE：基于零样本工作流推理的具身操作智能体控制
translated_abstract: 通用操作既需要对任务约束进行语义推理，也需要可靠地执行富含接触的动作。我们提出了 ACE，这是一个智能体操作框架，它将高层语言智能体与可复用的掩码条件视觉运动策略相结合。给定一条开放式指令，该智能体能够解决语义约束、将对象绑定到目标角色，并将任务分解为由可追踪的抓取-放置掩码所表示的可执行转移动作。执行反馈支持结果评估、重新定位与重试，同时持久化的对象与任务上下文能够在操作改变可见线索时保留先前的关联。我们在两个物理多步骤桌面任务上评估了 ACE：语义公式组装和约束检索。视觉运动策略仅在通用的抓取-放置演示上训练，并在没有任一评估任务完整演示的情况下复用，从而实现任务级别的（泛化能力）。
tldr: ACE 框架将高层语言智能体与可复用的掩码条件视觉运动策略相结合，通过零样本工作流推理处理开放式指令，无需针对特定任务的完整演示即可完成多步骤物理具身操作任务。
en_tdlr: ACE composes a high-level language agent with a reusable mask-conditioned visuomotor policy, enabling zero-shot embodied manipulation of open-ended instructions and completing multi-step physical tasks without task-specific full demonstrations.
